description: Synthesized clicks and drags against a tagged c11 build on the operator's live machine hijack their cursor and focus. On 2026-09-29 a builder's drag-validation scripts collided with Atin working on Hyperion. Give each c11 validation run its own sandbox: a macOS VM or a separate user session, with its own display, so computer-use agents can drive clicks and drags freely without touching the operator's session. Atin's steer: a sandbox or VM per c11 instance is the real fix, probably not Atlas. Deliver a script that stands one up with a tagged build, and update skills/c11-computer-use to prefer it.
title: Sandboxed c11 instances for computer-use validation
